scene: You climb the iron rungs onto the brightly tiled cinema rooftop.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view along a rooftop. On the far left stands a brass telescope on a tripod. To the left sits a brick chimney. The boy with dark hair and skateboard stands centre-left beside a glowing glass skylight hatch. Up high, pennant flags flap. On the far right, a yellow zeppelin waits tethered.
shown: A brass coin-operated telescope mounted on an iron swivel at the far left
A glowing glass skylight hatch bolted shut in the centre floor
A tiny yellow zeppelin tethered to a roof post on the far right

variants.scene: Cool evening air greets you on the breezy city rooftop.
Chimney smoke drifts past as you search around for {quest}.
Festive party lights glow above the quiet brick chimneys.
